items.title: New address
items.text: HatRack now lives at hatrack.mkcworkspace.com. Tasks are saved per address, so the old github.io copy shows a notice with a backup button; restore the backup here with Configure → Data → Restore.

items.title: Hosted on Vercel
items.text: Vercel builds and serves the site from the GitHub repository, and its build refuses changes that are undocumented or missing from the change log. GitHub Actions still refreshes the screenshots, guide and tour.

changelog.title: A change log, and updates that fit your role

items.title: Change log
items.text: Configure → Change log lists every release and every change in order, with filters and downloads (CSV, Markdown, JSON) for your records.

items.title: What’s new, made for you
items.text: After an update, HatRack opens an illustrated summary of the changes that apply to you, with a Show me button on each. Help → What’s new shows it again.

items.title: Updates for your role
items.text: Choose Everyday use or Admin for this device. Everyday users see changes to daily work; admins also see setup changes. Applying an admin’s setup template switches a new team member to Everyday use.

items.title: The log can’t skip a change
items.text: Publishing stops if the app changed without a new version and a change-log entry, and a CHANGELOG.md file in the repository is rebuilt from the same list.

items.title: Getting-started tour
items.text: Step-by-step slides with real screenshots — one track for everyday use, one for setting up. Opens on first launch; Help → Getting started tour any time.

items.title: What’s new after every update
items.text: When HatRack is updated, you get a short tour of what changed. Help → What’s new shows it again.

items.title: Docs that keep up with the app
items.text: Screenshots, the guide and the tour are rebuilt with every update, and the build stops if a new feature isn’t documented.

items.title: Published automatically
items.text: HatRack is hosted with GitHub Pages; every push rebuilds the app and its docs and republishes the site.

changelog.title: Subtasks, colors and the visual guide

items.title: Subtasks with drag-to-nest
items.text: Drop a card on the middle of another card — on the board or in the outline — to make it a subtask. Up to three levels.

items.title: Three-line previews
items.text: Long titles and notes fold away; Show more opens notes, subnotes and subtasks.

items.title: Card colors and right-click menu
items.text: Tint any card; right-click for color, subtasks, nesting and moving.

items.title: Drag in the outline
items.text: Reorder, move and nest tasks, and move subnotes between tasks.

items.title: Setup templates
items.text: Share one structure with a team; Restore → Apply setup merges it by name.

items.title: Visual guide
items.text: An illustrated guide to every screen, menu and setting, opened from Help.

items.title: Home-screen icon
items.text: Add HatRack to a phone’s home screen; it gets its own icon.

items.title: Quick add with shortcuts
items.text: Type a task and press Enter; @group, #type, !priority, ~time, ^date and *repeat fill in the details.

items.title: Import long lists
items.text: Paste notes or open a .txt, .md or .csv file. Headings become groups, keywords sort the rest, and repeats merge into one card.

items.title: Triage
items.text: Sort unsorted tasks one at a time, with one key press each.

items.title: Visual board
items.text: Drag cards between columns to move them, Alt-drag to copy, paste text to add; columns and rows can be any field.

items.title: List, Outline and Reports
items.text: A sortable table, a printable outline by group, and the numbers: hours, overdue, next 14 days.

items.title: Notes, subnotes and attachments
items.text: Each task holds notes, a subnote checklist, links and files kept in the browser.

items.title: Export to your task app
items.text: Todoist, Asana, spreadsheet CSV, Markdown, plain list, calendar (.ics) and HatRack files.

items.title: Configure the structure
items.text: Parents, entities and sub-branches with auto-sort keywords; task types, priorities, statuses, durations and custom fields.

items.title: Backups and restore
items.text: Download everything as a file; restore it by merging or replacing.
